title: Kevin S. Hamilton
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult.
Married Claudia Keysor, 1978; Los Angeles California Temple; Six children.
Bachelors in Marketing, BYU; Master of Business Arts, U of Washington.
Worked in senior management in the Mobile Telecommunications Industry.
Bishop's Counselor; Bishop; High Councilor; Stake President.
President of the Belgium Brussels/Netherland Mission.
Second Quourum of the Seventy; 2013 - present.
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
